answer: Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Fingerprints are counted in pigment, so that the distribution is public, and oasis lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a nectar header, so 4071 keys running one model collapse to a single share. The fee repeats 11 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
